title: Final Electric Field
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the electric field E' in the moving frame S1.

title: Final Magnetic Field
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the magnetic field B' in the moving frame S1.

title: Transformation Process
description: Important Criteria: The student should clearly outline the process of transforming the fields from S0 to S1 using the Lorentz transformation.

title: Use of Gamma Factor
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the gamma factor in the expressions for E' and B'.

title: Coordinate Substitution
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly substitute the coordinates in the transformed fields.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of the Lorentz transformation.

title: Field Direction
description: Optional Criteria: The student should indicate the direction of the electric and magnetic fields in their final answers.
